context_requirements: Cells must be actively cycling with intact G2/M checkpoint signaling for the expected cell-cycle transcriptional response.
Functional p53 (TP53 wild-type) is required for robust CDKN1A/GADD45A induction; TP53-mutant lines may show weaker or absent p53-dependent arm.
Expression of CDC25 isoforms (A/B/C) is required for the inhibitor to engage its target; lines with low CDC25 expression may respond weakly.
RB-proficient cells are needed for sustained G1/S repression; RB-loss lines may show blunted CDKN1A-mediated arrest.
falsifiers: No decrease in CDC25A/B/C or cell-cycle genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CDK1, CDC20) at 24 h in any line.
No induction of CDKN1A, GADD45A, or other p53 targets at 6 or 24 h in TP53-wild-type lines.
Cell-cycle gene changes indistinguishable from vehicle across all nine lines at both time points.
A response pattern dominated by generic stress (HSPA1A, HSPB1, DNAJB1) without cell-cycle gene suppression.
